domain: Circular Economy B2B SaaS for Hoteliers
design_philosophy: Premium Apple/Dyson style 3D experience. High structural clarity (Swiss grid) mixed with organic earthy tones. Focus on deep contrasts, highly polished scroll-driven 3D interactions, and clean, generous spacing to let the product breathe.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. High asymmetry in feature sections. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).

nav.style: Glassmorphism (Crystal variant). backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/40 sticky top-0 z-50
nav.elements: Brand logo, 4 key links, CTA 'Vols provar?' Button.

hero.style: Split layout or full-screen immersive canvas. 3D Model sits prominently in the hero area or right half.
hero.overlay: Subtle grain texture or extremely light radial gradient to keep text readable.
hero.cta: Solid Primary (#1A5336) button, rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-white hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A5336] text-white hover:bg-[#133D27] rounded-full transition-all shadow-md font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0B2016] border border-[#E2E8E4] hover:bg-[#F3F5F4] rounded-full transition-all font-medium

forms.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-white border border-[#E2E8E4] rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#A6E08A] focus:border-transparent text-[#0B2016]

three_d_experience.model_requirements: A segmented 3D mattress model (e.g., Cover, Foam Layer, Springs, Base).

interactions.scroll_driven_disassembly: Use `@react-three/drei` ScrollControls. Map scroll progress (using useScroll) to the Y-axis position of individual layers to create an 'exploded view' as the user scrolls down.

three_d_experience.lighting: Studio lighting setup. Ambient light (intensity 0.5) + Directional Light (intensity 1.5, cast shadow) + Environment map (preset='city' or 'apartment') for photorealistic reflections.

sections.name: Hero
sections.content: Headline about hotel mattress circular economy, 3D rotating mattress, 'Vols provar?' CTA.

sections.name: Lifecycle & Features
sections.content: Scroll-driven section. As user scrolls, mattress explodes. Text blocks appear explaining 8-year useful life, threshold alerts, and maintenance logs.

sections.name: Digital Passport & Blockchain
sections.content: High-tech clean bento grid layout. Shows digital passport, unequivocal blockchain-backed code, and carbon footprint tracking.

sections.name: Stakeholders Ecosystem
sections.content: Logos and connections to Manufacturers, TIRGY (Waste managers), Certifiers, and Red Cross. Visual node-based or clean grid design.

sections.name: Pricing & Contact
sections.content: Freemium pricing model info. 'Vols provar? / Demo' triggering a Contact Form modal or inline section.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Text over images must have soft gradient scrims.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the 3D canvas (fallback to static image if enabled).
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cta-hero-demo').

hero_ambient.description: Elegant hotel room in Dubai with ornate decor and plush bedding (Use with heavy white/light overlay to preserve text contrast).

logistics_warehouse.description: Warehouse and logistics for TIRGY / Waste Manager section.

sustainability_texture.description: Organic green leaf texture for circular economy thematic background accents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML and Tailwind for the layout, reserving Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like the Contact form (Input, Textarea, Dialog/Modal) or specific buttons.
Set up a global canvas for the 3D model, utilizing ScrollControls from drei to bind the exploded view animation of the mattress layers to the scroll position.
Strictly follow the color palette provided (Greens/Earth Tones) to meet the 'Colors verds' requirement.
Ensure all text is written in Catalan.
Maintain the layout spacing generous (p-8 to p-16) adhering to the Apple/Dyson premium aesthetic.
Use the provided image URLs to support the narrative, applying appropriate opacities/overlays when text sits on top.
Implement the 'Vols provar?' CTA to open a contact modal using Shadcn Dialog.
